2024_general.fact: The county 'Election Results' page (tomgreencountytx.gov/page/ele.ElectionsResults) lists for Nov 2024 only 'Official Cumulative Results for Presidential Election 2024' (November_5_Cumulative_Results.pdf, 'Cumulative Results Report ... Official Results', Run Time 10:27 AM, Run Date 11/27/2024) and 'Official Precinct Results for Presidential Election 2024' (344 pages, Run Time 10:29 AM, Run Date 11/27/2024); page/open serves no Last-Modified. Five searches (site-restricted and local news) found no Nov 2024 election-night unofficial file (only 110524finalOffCumulaRes.pdf, official). No Clarity (elections.json 404); Wayback branch has no captures (CDX empty). No election-night file survives, so UNDETERMINED.

2026_primary.fact: San Angelo LIVE story 'Here's How the March 3 Primary Went in Tom Green County' (2026-03-04) links https://www.tomgreencountytx.gov/upload/page/0091/docs/2026/March2026/6thUnofficialCumulativeresults032026.pdf (not linked from the county page now). Scanned 20-page PDF (Canon DR-C240), read by rendering pages: every page is 'Cumulative Results Report / Tom Green County / Unofficial Results / 030326 Primary Results / Run Time 11:20 PM / Run Date 03/03/2026', 'Registered Voters 16497 of 144936 = 11.38%', 'Precincts Reporting 0 of 70 = 0.00%', county totals by Absentee / Early / Election Day columns, '*** End of report ***' on page 20; no per-precinct pages. PDF CreationDate 2026-03-04 05:26:28 UTC; server Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 05:52:19 GMT (11:52 PM CST Mar 3, election night). Its 16,497 ballots equal the 'Preliminary Election Reconciliation - Unofficial Totals' (PreliminaryElectionReconciliation030326.pdf, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 05:54:48 GMT, ballots counted 16,497; no candidate votes), so the 6th update is the final unofficial count. Precinct numbers first appear in '030326OfficialPrecinctResults.pdf' (709 pages, 'Precinct Results Report ... Official Results', CreationDate 2026-03-26, Last-Modified Wed, 01 Apr 2026 13:17:02 GMT). No unofficial precinct report found on the results page or by search. DECISIONS 67: (i) met by the 11:20 PM / 11:52 PM county-totals file; (ii) met: no unofficial precinct report known. Updates 1 to 5 are not online; see rationale.

2026_runoff.fact: San Angelo LIVE stories link two county files: https://www.tomgreencountytx.gov/upload/page/0091/docs/2026/May2026/report%202.pdf (story 2026-05-26 20:37 CDT) and https://www.tomgreencountytx.gov/upload/page/0091/docs/2026/May2026/final%20unofficial.pdf (story 2026-05-27). Both scanned 2-page 'Cumulative Results Report ... 052626 Primary Runoff Election ... Unofficial Results', county totals only ('Precincts Reporting 0 of 24'). report 2: Run Time 8:05 PM 05/26/2026, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:26:52 GMT (8:26 PM CDT), Election Day column partial (Paxton ED 549). final unofficial: Run Time 8:49 PM 05/26/2026, CreationDate 2026-05-27 02:10:05 UTC, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 02:36:59 GMT (9:36 PM CDT), Paxton 4,377 / Cornyn 2,450. Precinct numbers first in 'PROElectionOfficialPrecinctResults.pdf' (24 pages, 'Precinct Results Report ... Official Results', Run Time 2:09 PM Run Date 06/08/2026, Last-Modified Mon, 08 Jun 2026 21:08:17 GMT). 052626PROUnofficialCumulativeResults.pdf is a later county-totals rerun (Run Date 06/02/2026, Last-Modified 03 Jun 2026). No unofficial precinct report found. Rule 43 / DECISIONS 67 met.

rationale: Primary and runoff are LATER from check 2: county-posted unofficial cumulative (county totals) reports with printed run times and upload times on election night, no unofficial precinct report known, precinct numbers first in official canvass reports (Apr 1 and Jun 8). 2024 general UNDETERMINED (only Nov 27 official files survive). Two elections agree: COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med (check 2). On the 6th-update question: the surviving primary file is named the 6th unofficial update and updates 1 to 5 are not online. Condition (ii) of the DECISIONS 67 reading asks whether anything shows precinct numbers with election-day votes were posted that night; the missing updates are, by their series name, earlier cumulative (county-totals) runs of the same report, and the 6th is the final unofficial count (matches the reconciliation's 16,497 ballots), so a precinct release on election night would most likely have accompanied or followed it, and none is known. Their absence therefore does not show precinct numbers were posted, and (ii) is met; the residual gap (we cannot read updates 1 to 5) is a reason for caution, not a reason to call the election UNDETERMINED under the rule as written. The runoff, which has two surviving election-night updates and no precinct report, independently shows the same practice.

comparison_notes.2024_general: Same (UNDETERMINED). Both found only the Nov 27, 2024 official cumulative and precinct reports. Research's '110524finalOffCumulaRes.pdf' has the same content hash (59b54198...) as the results page's November_5_Cumulative_Results.pdf and Last-Modified Tue, 03 Dec 2024 15:23:48 GMT (confirmed in the fetch store).
comparison_notes.2026_primary: Same (LATER, check 2), same file and times: 6thUnofficialCumulativeresults032026.pdf, county totals on all pages, Run Time 11:20 PM 03/03/2026, Last-Modified 05:52:19 GMT (11:52 PM CST); official precinct report uploaded Apr 1. On the 6th-update question: the file name shows five earlier election-night updates that are no longer online. I still hold that condition (ii) of the DECISIONS 67 reading is met: (ii) asks whether anything shows precinct numbers with election-day votes were posted that night, and nothing does; the missing files belong, by their name, to the same 'Unofficial Cumulative results' series (county totals), and the 6th is the final unofficial count (its 16,497 ballots equal the election-night Preliminary Election Reconciliation), so a precinct release that night would most likely sit alongside it and none is known; the runoff, with two surviving election-night updates and no precinct report, shows the same practice. The gap (updates 1 to 5 unread) is a real limit, which research also states ('removed files cannot be ruled out'), but under the rule as written absence of a precinct report is what (ii) requires, not proof that none existed. If the owner wants (ii) to require that every election-night update be readable, this election would become UNDETERMINED and the county tag would fall to low confidence on the runoff alone (still COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS).
comparison_notes.2026_runoff: Same (LATER, check 2), same two files: report 2.pdf (Run Time 8:05 PM, Last-Modified 01:26:52 GMT = 8:26 PM CDT) and final unofficial.pdf (Run Time 8:49 PM, Last-Modified 02:36:59 GMT = 9:36 PM CDT), both county totals; official precinct report Jun 8.
